name: Fidelity
source: Fidelity Bank Plc audited consolidated and separate statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income FY2025, page 53, group column
source_url: doclib.ngxgroup.com Fidelity Bank Plc annual report 2025
source_note: Fidelity Bank Plc Reports and Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, Consolidated and Separate Statement of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income, page 53. The statement is published in N millions, which is the unit the file already used for Profit Before Tax, so Revenue is the printed group Gross Earnings of 1,519,697 and 1,043,401. Income Tax is the total tax charge, the printed income tax expense of 99,549 and 93,777 plus the windfall tax of 5,669 and 13,331, because profit before income and windfall taxes less that total reproduces the printed profit for the year of 242,444 exactly for FY2025 and to within one unit for FY2024. The stored row held the charge with a negative sign and no windfall tax.
